description: Ground truth for data/ships/pre-engineered.jsonc — the module variants that arrive already engineered, whether bought from the Merc-Coin shop or awarded for a community goal. A pre-engineered module has no symbol of its own, so each record pairs a base module `symbol` (joins to the module catalogues) with the `blueprint` baked in, the `grade` already applied, and an optional `experimental`. Neither symbol nor blueprint is unique on its own, and even (symbol, blueprint) repeats — the (symbol, blueprint, experimental) triple is the key. `counts` pins the catalogue size and its split by acquisition; `records` pins individual pairings; `multiVariant` pins that one base module carries several variants; `joins` pins that every record resolves against the module, blueprint and experimental catalogues.
